name: Christopher Nolan
biography: Christopher Edward Nolan CBE is a British-American filmmaker known for his Hollywood blockbusters with complex storytelling. He is considered a leading filmmaker of the 21st century. His accolades include two Academy Awards, two British Academy Film Awards, and two Golden Globe Awards.

name: Timothée Chalamet
place_of_birth: New York City, New York, USA
biography: Timothée Hal Chalamet is an American actor known for his roles in independent films and blockbusters. He has received various accolades, including nominations for an Academy Award, three Golden Globe Awards, and three BAFTA Film Awards.

name: Zendaya
biography: Zendaya Maree Stoermer Coleman is an American actress and singer. She has received numerous accolades, including two Primetime Emmy Awards and a Golden Globe Award. Time named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2022.

name: Cillian Murphy
biography: Cillian Murphy is an Irish actor. A recipient of an Academy Award, a BAFTA Film Award, and a Golden Globe Award, Murphy is celebrated for his intense performances across film, television, and stage.

name: Denis Villeneuve
biography: Denis Villeneuve OC CQ is a French-Canadian film director, producer, and screenwriter. An internationally acclaimed auteur, his films have received widespread critical praise and box office success worldwide.

name: Pedro Pascal
biography: Pedro Pascal is a Chilean and American actor. After nearly two decades of theater and guest television roles, Pascal rose to international prominence for starring roles in Game of Thrones, Narcos, The Mandalorian, and The Last of Us.
